description:
pattern     timeline-split / timeline
surface     dark
kit         ambient cyan orb behind sticky narrative anchor
form        Columns 1–5 hold a sticky narrative anchor with chapter heading and cinematic reflection text; columns 6–12 display four sticky timeline stages sequentially, each featuring an amber-accented year badge, reflection line, and high-contrast campus photo. On mobile, the sticky anchor precedes the vertically stacked timeline cards.
copy
  eyebrow      THE TIMELINE
  heading      Four Years, One Transformation
  reflection   I walked in not knowing where the code would lead me. Four years later, every challenge, lab night, and breakthrough has engineered who I am.
  stage-1-title YEAR 01 — THE BEGINNING
  stage-1-text  Stepping onto the Vavuniya campus as a fresher, navigating initial algorithms, foundational logic, and the uncharted terrain of higher technology.
  stage-2-title YEAR 02 — THE EXPLORATION
  stage-2-text  Diving deep into software architectures, full-stack environments, late-night debugging sessions, and collaborative hackathons with peers.
  stage-3-title YEAR 03 — THE TRANSFORMATION
  stage-3-text  Stepping into project leadership, tackling complex distributed engineering challenges, and guiding team dynamics under real deadline pressures.
  stage-4-title YEAR 04 — THE LAUNCH
  stage-4-text  Synthesizing four years of discipline into capstone engineering, research defense, and stepping forward ready for industry-grade impact.
image       16:9; series of four documentary photographs showing university matriculation, computer lab coding sessions, group project leadership, and final year capstone defense; placed inside each timeline card, treatment documentary; alt: Four-year university progression milestones of Tharindu Perera
motion      Sticky anchor pins on scroll at 0ms; timeline cards trigger text and image opacity reveal as each stage enters viewport threshold at 150ms.
plan check  heading "Four Years, One Transformation" placed; four sticky timeline stages (YEAR 01 — THE BEGINNING, YEAR 02 — THE EXPLORATION, YEAR 03 — THE TRANSFORMATION, YEAR 04 — THE LAUNCH) placed; short reflection line for each placed; one photo per stage placed.
layout_description: Two-column layout with left sticky narrative column and right sequential scrolling timeline card stack.
kit: ambient cyan orb behind sticky narrative anchor
